subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS replace the separate Agent and Session pages with compact Home controls while treating model selection as unavailable until the paired Phone advertises `model-controls`?
rationale: This is a user-facing navigation and cross-version protocol decision; the code and proof support the proposed behavior, but only the Android/Wear owner can accept the permanent interaction and upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve the paired-upgrade design
options.body: Accept the three-control Home workflow and capability-gated unavailability on older paired Phone builds after the exact-head Android checks complete.

options.title: Retain separate context pages
options.body: Keep the current page structure until a different old-Phone fallback or migration behavior is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve the paired-upgrade design
recommendation.body: Accept the three-control Home workflow and capability-gated unavailability on older paired Phone builds after the exact-head Android checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR is assigned to them and its hardening commits show direct ownership of the affected Android/Wear protocol and state paths.
